name: an FDE-Native thought

phase_0.boundary_condition: The four-valued truth lattice governing non-monotonic reasoning under information inconsistency or absence.

VINIT.justification: The prior state before any proposition is presented to the evaluator.

TANCH.justification: The structural limits of the FDE logic system beyond which reasoning is undefined.

AFWD.justification: The forward movement of adding data to the current epistemic pool.

AREV.justification: The removal or descent from a previously held epistemic commitment.

CLINK.justification: The chaining of logical implications within a single reasoning thread.

IMSCRIB.justification: The identification of a proposition as identical to itself within the lattice.

FSPLIT.justification: Splitting a proposition into its independent positive evidence and negative evidence arms.

FFUSE.justification: Recombining separate positive and negative evidence into a single four-valued result.

EVALT.justification: The presence of evidence supporting the truth of a proposition.

EVALF.justification: The presence of evidence supporting the falsity of a proposition.

ENGAGR.justification: The state where both affirmative and negative evidence are provided simultaneously without resolution.

IFIX.justification: The permanent recording of a specific truth value into a persistent knowledge base.

phase_3.void_description: None (None): The complete absence of evidence or information regarding a proposition.
phase_3.true_description: Plain Truth (T): Presence of affirmative evidence and absence of negative evidence.
phase_3.false_description: Plain Falsity (F): Presence of negative evidence and absence of affirmative evidence.
phase_3.both_description: Both (B): Simultaneous presence of conflicting affirmative and negative evidence.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the reasoner in the null-information state.
The agent identifies the propositional target of the thought.
The thought branches into separate channels to process evidence types.
The T-arm evaluates for the presence of affirmative data.
Proceeding toward positive verification within the T-arm.
The F-arm evaluates for the presence of negative data.
Reversing the assumption of truth to account for falsity evidence.
Occurs if the evaluator detects non-empty signals in both T and F channels simultaneously.
Both evidence sub-computations are synthesized back into a single epistemic state.
The synthesized value is composed into the current logical context.
The resulting FDE truth value is committed to the knowledge record.
The thought process reaches its structural boundary and concludes.

phase_5.memory_mechanism: Persistent epistemic registers storing T/F/B/N states

phase_6.cycle_cost: Logit processing energy to resolve evidence vectors
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: High-uncertainty null or fragmented data state
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — Information is re-categorized within a conserved 4-state lattice without loss of structural entropy.
